name: Mailcheck
label: UserCheck (Mailcheck.ai) — disposable email / domain signals
description: Official UserCheck REST (Mailcheck.ai rebrand). GET /email/{email} and GET /domain/{domain} at https://api.usercheck.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode. MX/disposable signals only — not a mailbox inbox. Customer owns the UserCheck account. Minimize: send only the address/domain being checked. api_key is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. email.check requires email. domain.check requires domain. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"email.check","email":"ada@example.com"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'email.check' | 'domain.check'.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email to verify for email.check. Path /email/{email}. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Domain to verify for domain.check. Path /domain/{domain}. Example: example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: email.check | domain.check.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: UserCheck API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Dashboard: https://app.usercheck.com/

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
